title: rudywizz-motion composition
description: A video made of scenes played back to back. Generated by scripts/gen-schema.mjs — do not edit by hand.

lang.description: Language for casing rules, e.g. "tr" (i → İ)

bpm.description: Tempo for beat-synced styles and the beat-punch camera

audio.description: Audio file path (relative to this JSON)

music.description: Code-made, royalty-free music as long as the video; ducks under voice lines. Ignored when "audio" is set.

bpm.description: Tempo (defaults to the mood, or the composition bpm)

camera.description: Camera move: a preset name or { preset, amount, shake, keys }

transition.description: Transition into the next scene (sits on the scene it leaves)

colors.description: Bar colours, in item order (array of hex)

text.default: Write it / cut it / stamp it / ship it

offset.description: Seconds before the first beat (sync with your audio)

hot.description: Accent ink used on every 4th word

text.default: Bu altyazılar tamamen kodla üretildi ve şeffaf arka planla dışa aktarılabilir

pill.description: Highlight colour behind the active word

times.description: Optional array of start seconds per word (from your transcript)

text.default: Design / Motion / Code / Sound / Story / Launch

colors.description: Card colours, used in turn (array of hex)

images.description: Image paths/URLs, one per card (the line becomes its caption)

turns.description: Extra full turns before it settles (0–3)

text.default: are you awake? / >yes why / I just rendered a whole video / with code. no editor. / >wait what / >send it NOW

time.description: Date chip above the thread ("" to hide)

seen.description: Read receipt under your last message ("" to hide)

colors.description: Face colours, used in turn (array of hex)

text.description: Script: `Name [pose, emotion, shot]: words`, one beat per line. `* text` narration, a 0–1 number in the tags walks there
text.default: Pip [wave, happy]: Hi, I'm Pip! / Momo [surprised]: You can talk?! / Pip [shrug, smug]: I'm drawn by code. / Momo [think, thinking]: So... I am too? / Pip [point, wink]: Every wobbly line. / Momo [celebrate, starstruck]: That is SO cool! / Momo [jump, laughing]: / Pip [dance, excited]:

cast.description: Characters: [{ name, body (bean|block|ball|tall), color, x (0–1), size }]

boil.description: Line redraws per second (8–12 = hand-drawn; 0 = still)

sheet.description: true = model sheet: every emotion in a grid

voices.description: Audio files, one per spoken line in script order (null skips a line). Each line lasts as long as its audio, the mouth follows its loudness, and the render mixes them in

subtitle.description: Small mono line under the title (empty to hide)

colors.description: Datamosh block colours (array of hex)

every.description: Seconds between the small glitches after the intro

dot.description: Halftone cell size in px at 1080 wide

caption.description: Small print at the bottom ("" to hide)

text.default: Make it simple, / then make it move.

highlight.description: Words to highlight (array). Default: the last line

from.description: Year the counter starts from (default: year − 120)

gold.description: Three-stop gold gradient for the year

chrome.description: Puff ramp from rim to crown (array of hex)

face.description: Chrome face gradient top→bottom: sky, horizon, ground (array of hex)

splatter.description: Small satellite splashes around each drop (true/false)

text.description: One board per line (split with " / " or new lines, max 4)
text.default: Hoş geldiniz / Open 24/7 / Çay · Kahve · Tost

colors.description: LED colour per board (array of hex)

cols.description: LED columns per board (wider = smaller dots)

accent.description: Accent bar and role strip colour

text.default:
Gece uzun, şehir susmuyor
Beat’i aç, gerisi bende
Her kare kodla çizildi

times.description: Array of start seconds, one per line (default: evenly spread)

route.description: Array of places: any city, region or country in ~25 languages, "City, Country" or "City, State" to disambiguate ("Portland, Maine", "Valencia, Venezuela"), "lat,lon" strings or {name, lat, lon}

mode.description: globe | flat | country (one country with its states/provinces) | auto

country.description: Country for mode "country" (name in any language or ISO code, e.g. "Japan", "Almanya", "BR"); auto-detected when every stop is in one country

highlight.description: Countries (any language, e.g. "Türkiye", "Deutschland") or states/provinces to tint

colors.description: Tube colour per line (array of hex)

text.description: A number followed by a label, e.g. "10000 takipçi"

prefix.description: Text before the number, e.g. "$" or "+"

suffix.description: Text after the number, e.g. "%" or "K"

text.default: Stay curious / keep moving / make things

Sevgili kardeşim,
Burada kışlar uzun, ama şehir hâlâ güzel.
Her akşam limana inip gemileri sayıyorum.
Yakında dönerim.

seal.description: Letter(s) embossed in the wax seal ("" for none)

colors.description: Particle colours, blended left → right (array of hex)

morphAt.description: Second at which the sphere starts turning into text

pixel.description: Size of one game pixel in output px (4–10)

subtitle.description: Blinking line under the title ("" to hide)

text.description: Script played in order: `Name [pose, mood, place]: words` per line ( / or newline between lines). *word* is highlighted
text.default: Bit [happy]: Hi. I am Bit. / Bit [question]: Give me a voice file and I will lip-sync it. / Bit [love]: Or just text. I am flexible.

cast.description: Characters: [{ name, rig: "path/to/rig.json" | "bit", side: left|right, scale }]. rig.json lists the layer PNGs of a pixel character (see SKILL.md)

lines.description: Timed lines instead of a script: [{ who, at (s), text, voice (audio file), pose, mood, place }]. A line with only `at` + `place` just moves the hosts

voices.description: With a script: audio files, one per line in order. Each line lasts as long as its audio and the mouth follows it

place.description: Starting layout: corner (small, bottom) | stage (big, centre) | left | right | hidden

captions.description: bubble (speech bubbles, words appear as they are said) | none

bg.description: Background when used as a scene (as an overlay it is transparent)

backdrop.description: none | studio — a soft-lit stage behind the hosts when used as a scene

label.description: Small mono caption at the top of the studio backdrop (e.g. "RUDYWIZZ · 03 · HOW IT WORKS")

items.description: Array of [label, value] rows printed above the message

date.description: Date/time line (fixed string so renders are reproducible)

sky.description: Sky gradient top → horizon (array of 3 hex)

sun.description: Sun gradient top → bottom (array of 3 hex)

resolve.description: Seconds for the whole text to decode

hud.description: Show the DECODING readout and progress bar (true/false)

channel.description: Channel number shown in the green OSD

title.description: Header above the board ("" to hide)

accent.description: Colour of the header + last row

text.description: Script: one beat per line — `Name [pose, emotion, shot]: words`. `* text` = narration card, `[wide]` = camera-only beat, a number 0–1 in the tags walks there
